lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines. Spacing is relatively tight on the anterior shoulder region, widens significantly across the mid-torso, and narrows again toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 10th vertical line from the anterior, where the dorsal segment splits into two distinct paths toward the spine.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 2, and 12 are abbreviated segments that terminate before reaching the ventral midline or dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of three discrete white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, positioned above the hock in a triangular formation.

other_distinctive_markers: Single high-contrast white spot on the lower malar region; white horizontal patch on the ventral neck; white contrast bands on distal leg segments proximal to black-pigmented hooves.
